card.name: Ending of bolus and hyphema
card.fires_on: The final piece of a split medical word, mainly the 'us' in bolus (bolus dose, bolus injection) and the 'ph' in hyphema. It also fires on a few other word endings.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Scattered endings of other long words, such as pinnately or coadministration.
